description: This file is a shell script for managing a service named 'cosa'. It defines functions to start, stop, and restart the service, handles system events, and sources external utility scripts. The script is used for service orchestration within a larger system, likely in a Linux-based environment.

methods.name: cosa_start
methods.description: Starts the 'cosa' service by executing the './cosa_start.sh' script within '/usr/ccsp' directory.

methods.name: service_start
methods.description: Handles the startup process of the 'cosa' service, including status updates and invoking 'cosa_start'.

methods.name: service_stop
methods.description: Stops the 'cosa' service by killing relevant processes and updating system status.
